Resolve the path to the log file

Source: R/vtamR_helper_functions.R
get_log_file.Rd

Internal helper that determines which log file path should be used, following the priority order: an explicitly supplied file argument, then the vtamR.log_file package option, then a default "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory. If the resolved path is not NA, the function ensures that the parent directory of the log file exists (creating it if necessary).

Usage

get_log_file(file = NULL)

Arguments

file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file, NA to disable logging, or NULL (the default) to resolve the path automatically from the vtamR.log_file option or the default "vtamR_log.csv".

Value

A character string with the resolved log file path, or NA if logging is disabled.
